medina.name: Medina of Tunis
medina.price_text: Free to enter · small fees for individual monuments
medina.hours: Streets open all day · shops roughly 09:00–19:00, closed Sunday morning
medina.tip: Enter through Bab el Bhar and walk to the Zitouna Mosque early; the souks get crowded by midday.
medina.best: Morning, before the heat and crowds

sidibousaid.name: Sidi Bou Said
sidibousaid.price_text: Free to walk · cafés charge for drinks
sidibousaid.tip: Come late afternoon for the light on the blue doors, then stay for sunset over the bay.

bardo.name: Bardo National Museum
bardo.price_text: Small entry fee; check current price on the day
bardo.hours: Closed Monday · roughly 09:00–17:00, check on the day
bardo.tip: The Roman mosaics are the highlight; allow at least two hours and go in the morning.

carthage.name: Archaeological Site of Carthage
carthage.price_text: Combined ticket for several sites; check on the day
carthage.hours: Roughly 08:30–17:00, shorter in winter; check on the day
carthage.tip: The ruins are spread out; take the TGM train and plan to walk between the Baths of Antoninus and the hilltop.

brik.name: Brik
brik.price_text: Cheap street snack; a few TND per piece
brik.hours: Most cafés and snack stalls serve it through the day
brik.tip: A thin pastry parcel with egg and tuna; eat it fresh and hot, and ask for it without harissa if you dislike heat.

rades.name: Stade Olympique de Rades
rades.price_text: Match tickets vary; check on the day
rades.tip: Only worth a trip if a football match is on; check the fixture list and buy tickets in advance.

uthina.name: Uthina
uthina.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
uthina.hours: Daylight hours; check on the day
uthina.tip: A quiet Roman site with an amphitheatre and mosaics; arrange transport in advance as it is off the usual tourist route.
uthina.best: Morning; bring water and sun protection

zitouna.name: Zitouna Mosque
zitouna.price_text: Free for the courtyard · non-Muslims may not enter the prayer hall
zitouna.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
zitouna.tip: Dress modestly and look at the courtyard from the doorway; the best view of the minaret is from the surrounding souks.

souks.name: Souks of the Medina
souks.price_text: Free to browse · bargain for anything you buy
souks.tip: Walk the covered lanes for carpets, copper and perfume; agree a price before you commit and expect to haggle.

centralmarket.name: Central Market (Marché Central)
centralmarket.price_text: Free to enter · pay for what you buy
centralmarket.tip: Go early for fish, spices and olives; the small stalls upstairs serve cheap fresh lunches.
centralmarket.best: Morning, before it closes for the day

habibbourguiba.name: Avenue Habib Bourguiba walk
habibbourguiba.hours: Always open · cafés through the day
habibbourguiba.tip: Stroll the wide avenue from the clock tower to the cathedral and stop for a coffee at a pavement café.

byrsa.name: Byrsa Hill viewpoint
byrsa.price_text: Free · museum on the hill may charge
byrsa.tip: Climb to the cathedral terrace for a wide view over the Gulf of Tunis and the ruins below.

tgm.name: TGM train ride to Sidi Bou Said
tgm.price_text: Cheap single ticket; buy at the station
tgm.hours: Frequent service through the day; check times on the day
tgm.tip: A simple, cheap way to reach Carthage and Sidi Bou Said; keep your ticket for the exit gates.

marsa.name: La Marsa corniche
marsa.tip: Walk the seafront promenade in the evening and pick a café for mint tea and a view of the sea.

darbenabdallah.name: Dar Ben Abdallah museum
darbenabdallah.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
darbenabdallah.hours: Closed Monday · roughly 09:00–16:00, check on the day
darbenabdallah.tip: A small palace museum showing traditional Tunisian home life; a calm break from the souks.
darbenabdallah.best: Midday, when the streets are hottest

cafedesnattes.name: Café des Nattes
cafedesnattes.price_text: Pay per drink; check the price before ordering
cafedesnattes.tip: Sit on the mats inside for mint tea and a view over the village; it is a classic Sidi Bou Said stop.

carthagebaths.name: Baths of Antoninus
carthagebaths.price_text: Covered by the Carthage combined ticket; check on the day
carthagebaths.tip: The huge columns by the sea are the most photographed spot in Carthage; go early for shade and space.
